name: RRCL Site Purchase Requisition By Item and Site
query:
SELECT 
    item.rrcl_name,
    pr.work_site,
    SUM(pri.qty) AS ordered,
    IFNULL(se.delivered_qty, 0) AS delivered
FROM `tabRRCL Purchase Requisition Item` AS pri
LEFT JOIN `tabRRCL Purchase Requisition` AS pr 
    ON pri.parent = pr.name
LEFT JOIN `tabRRCL Item` AS item 
    ON pri.item = item.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        sei.item AS item_code,
        se.work_site,
        SUM(sei.qty) AS delivered_qty
    FROM `tabRRCL Stock Entry Item` AS sei
    LEFT JOIN `tabRRCL Stock Entry` AS se 
        ON sei.parent = se.name
    GROUP BY sei.item, se.work_site
) AS se 
    ON pri.item = se.item_code
    AND pr.work_site = se.work_site
GROUP BY pri.item, pr.work_site;
report_name: RRCL Site Purchase Requisition By Item and Site
